overview_description.description:
Cuckoo is an always-available, in-house realtime translator. Cuckoo instantly learns the technical details of your conversation from your keywords and documents and interprets into over 20 languages—customized for your specific industry and organization. 

Global teams like Snowflake, PagerDuty, Weights & Biases, dbt Labs, and SeAH rely on Cuckoo for multilingual meetings, events, business trips, and more.
